overall: The AG found the disbanded School Start Times Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by never creating or approving minutes, rejected the chair's memo as a remedy, ordered minutes reconstructed within sixty days, and declined non-OML and vote-vacatur requests.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee's subcommittees, especially the School Start Times Subcommittee, failed to create and approve minutes for their meetings from 2016 to 2019.
allegations.key_passage: The School Committee does not dispute that the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to create and approve minutes for its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complainant raised unethical behavior and conflict of interest claims, which the School Committee's actions allegedly involved.
allegations.key_passage: Our office interprets and enforces the Open Meeting Law only; therefore, we decline to review allegations of violation of other laws and decline to review the school start time policy.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked the AG to review the School Committee's school start time policy vote.
allegations.key_passage: Our office interprets and enforces the Open Meeting Law only; therefore, we decline to review allegations of violation of other laws and decline to review the school start time policy.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked that the School Committee's votes be vacated because the subcommittee failed to keep minutes.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to vacate any votes taken by the School Committee, as the Complainant requests, because we find no evidence that the School Committee’s votes were taken in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Within sixty days of receipt of the determination, the School Committee must create and approve minutes for any Subcommittee meetings for which minutes have not yet been created and approved, using whatever means are available.
remedy_passage: Because the Subcommittee has been disbanded, we order the School Committee, within sixty days of receipt of this determination, to create and approve minutes for any Subcommittee meetings for which minutes have not yet been created and approved.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
